sentence: Huygens built the first pendulum clock in 1656. It kept time to about a minute a day.
claim: Christiaan Huygens completed his first pendulum clock in late 1656; its error was about a minute a day (sources differ: 15 s to 1 min a day).
source_title: EBSCO Research Starters, Huygens's Pendulum Clocks
note: End-card footnote (on screen, not spoken). Also APS News (https://aps.org/publications/apsnews/201706/history.cfm) and History of Information (15 min to 15 s a day). The card uses the cautious figure. Carried over from the 25 Oct claims sheet.
